t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are 2 sets of gnomes that vary in colour that hold different colour baskets. Try and find the highest yield coloured gnomes and basket and then stick with that until the yield starts to drop, and then pick another colour and look out for the rise in yield and stick with that one and so on.....

vb_textbox.text: Green, orange and brown gnomes hold a red basket and the remaining coloured gnomes hold a yellow basket. The aim is to pick the highest yield possible each turn. After a while the gnomes yields change, so try the other coloured set of gnomes and keep testing until you find the highest yield again. The highest yields will slowly go down in points, so that's when you want to try the other set of coloured gnomes. I hope my instructions are clear and good luck :-)
